title: Safe money for AI agents: x402 Doctor and presign-guard

card.title: AI agents now pay and sign on their own.
card.sub: One wrong signature can empty a wallet.

segments.text: AI agents now pay for APIs and sign transactions on their own. One wrong signature can empty a wallet.

card.title: Check first. Then pay or sign.
card.note: Paid per check, in USDC. No account, no API key.

segments.text: So we built two checks for the two risky moments: before an agent pays, and before it signs.
x402 Doctor checks a paid API the way a paying agent would. Here it diagnoses a broken one.
Every problem, with the reason and the fix. For developers the web check is free.

segments.label: In your agent: npm install x402-safe-fetch

lines.text: const safeFetch = createSafeFetch({ register, maxUsd: 0.05, diagnoseOnFailure: true });
→ 402 Payment Required: first a Doctor preflight, for a tenth of a cent
← go: pays the API, never above your budget
← no_go: throws, and nothing is paid

segments.text: For agents there's x402-safe-fetch. Before it pays an unknown API, it buys a Doctor preflight for a tenth of a cent. No-go means no payment.

segments.label: When a payment still fails

lines.text: ← the API answers 402 again after paying
→ one Doctor diagnosis, for one cent
diagnosisOf(res).checks → "Payment option is on Base Sepolia, not Base mainnet."

segments.text: And when a payment still fails, it buys one diagnosis for a cent that says exactly why.
The second check is presign-guard. It answers one question before an agent signs: is this safe?

segments.label: In your agent: npm install presign-guard-wallet

lines.text: → presign-guard checks exactly this approval, for one cent
✓ green signs · orange stops or asks you first

segments.text: presign-guard-wallet wraps the agent's wallet. Every transaction and signature is checked first. Green signs, orange asks, and red is never signed.

card.title: Every verdict is signed.
card.sub: A forged “green” is never a payment or a signature.
card.note: Your keys stay in your own code.

segments.text: Every verdict is cryptographically signed, and both packages check that signature. A forged green is never a payment or a signature. Your keys stay in your own code.
And it's all live: every call to the services, on lab.fizzl.eu.
Install presign-guard-wallet and x402-safe-fetch from npm, or try the free checks on the web. Safe money for AI agents.
